title: Clay Crafter
description: This is a data pack (My first one, yay) that makes it so that getting clay is easier with a bucket and dirt to get 8 clay balls, bringing more use to the dirt block
body:
This is my first time ever coding, and I'm so happy it works that I decided to share it with everyone (that's you!).

This mod lets you make clay without having to dig around in rivers and nearly drown. Simply combine a dirt block from the pile of dirt you got from terraforming projects you may or may not have with a bucket of water to craft 8 clay balls.

So whether you're building a brick house, a terracotta tower, or just need clay for another mod, this should make things a little easier. Enjoy!
